create_SGDW_optimizer: create an SGDW optimizer with params, learning rate, momentum, and weight decay settings
run_SGDW_step: run a single optimization step on the SGDW optimizer with an optional closure function
configure_MetaseqSGDW_args: configure the MetaseqSGDW optimizer by adding momentum and weight decay arguments to the parser
review_SGDW_step_fp16: review the SGDW step method to understand how it handles float16 and bfloat16 precision
test_SGDW_nesterov_momentum: test the SGDW optimizer with Nesterov momentum enabled and validate parameter updates
